title: payment-api: checkout timeout budget breached, mixed 502/503
symptom: Checkout p95 rose from 210ms to 3.9s. Responses are a mix of 502 and 503; 'cache acquisition timed out' dominates the log stream.
notes: Paged as SEV-2 because the 5xx ratio has not breached 5% yet. Same runbook as the March 5xx storm, which is why responders instinctively start with a restart.
